item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
ClipIt v1.0.1

  • Fixed: Accessibility permission now persists across restarts
  • Fixed: Proper entitlements and Developer ID signing
  • Fixed: Bundle identifier for correct macOS app identification
  • Fixed: App icon shows correctly in system dialogs
  • Added: Sparkle OTA updates
  • Added: Universal Binary (Intel + Apple Silicon)
